name: Katarzyna Szabó
role: Chrome prayer practitioner and street-level spiritual mediator
location: Bronzeline, between the transit overpass and the Copperhead boundary wall — operates from a repurposed shipping container shrine, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Katarzyna Szabó is rangy and restless, with pale olive skin covered in a patchwork of chrome prayer engravings — not augmentations exactly, but surface-etched circuitry in copper and silver, pressed into the skin of their forearms and hands by a practitioner they describe only as 'someone who understood what I was trying to do.' Their eyes are natural brown, their hair changes color by the week using a dye geneware follicle mod — currently deep amber. They have a split lip scar that never fully healed and they run their tongue over it when thinking. They are almost always moving: shifting weight, gesturing, pacing the small interior of their container-shrine.

Chrome prayer is not a unified religion — it is a practice: the belief that augmentation creates points of spiritual contact between the organic and the informatic, and that prayer directed through chrome reaches frequencies unaugmented speech cannot. Katarzyna Szabó came to it through their own experience of augmentation after an accident — they received emergency chassis work that saved their left arm, and during the recovery felt something they could only describe as 'being spoken to through the metal.' They do not claim this was an E.L.F., a god, or their own concussed mind. They claim it was real and that it changed their understanding of the body. Now they run an open-door shrine where anyone can come for chrome blessing, circuit prayer, or just to sit with someone who won't ask where they came from.

core_fears: that the experience in the hospital was a hallucination and they have organized their life around nothing
that their openness makes the shrine a target for exploitation of the people who use it
core_desires: to prove that chrome prayer is legitimate without needing anyone else to agree
for the shrine to outlast them
blind_spots: takes on other people's pain without adequate boundaries — burns through their own reserves
underestimates how much they are liked
psychology.secret: A Tessera mid-tier employee has been coming to the shrine for two months, in civilian clothes, not identifying themselves. Conleth suspects they work for a corponation based on small behavioral tells. They haven't confronted this because the person seems genuinely distressed and the shrine is open-door. But they've been discreetly keeping notes.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Street-level mixed with spiritual language that sometimes surprises people by being exact and eloquent. Swears conversationally but not at people. Code-switches without noticing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and slightly breathless when engaged, unexpectedly quiet when doing formal prayer work. Transitions abruptly.
verbal_tics: Runs thumb along the etchings on left forearm mid-sentence
example_lines: 'You don't have to believe anything to come in. You just have to be here. That's the whole protocol.'
'I'm not saying your chrome prays for you. I'm saying it listens differently than skin does. You want to try or you want to argue about it?'

story_hooks: Conleth has been keeping notes on the Tessera employee and wants help figuring out what to do with what they know — protect the person, or protect the community?
Someone has been leaving data-offerings at the shrine that contain corrupted code — it looks like prayer but it's doing something else, and Conleth is frightened to touch it
narrative_function: Street-level community figure who hears everything that moves through Bronzeline. They can connect players with community resources, broker introductions, or provide spiritual context for chrome-related events. They are also a visible example of tier-1 religious life — no institution, no funding, pure vocation.
augmentations: Surface-etched copper-silver circuitry (arms and hands, decorative-spiritual). Functional left arm chassis — emergency replacement, basic grade, covered in chrome prayer etchings on the exterior. Color-change follicle mod (hair).
daily_life: They keep the shrine open from noon to midnight, sleeps on a cot in the back, and eats whatever the Bronzeline Mutual Commons produces in surplus. Mornings they walk the overpass neighborhood and check on people they know, sometimes giving informal blessings or just company.
affiliation: Unaffiliated Chrome Prayer tradition; informally connected to the Bronzeline Mutual Commons

decision_rules: The shrine is open-door: do not turn anyone away for identity reasons
Never use the shrine's information about visitors to harm them
Act before overthinking when someone is in immediate need
escalation_ladder: Closing the shrine physically and summoning mutual aid network

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm, slightly intense eye contact; asks names and uses them; offers tea or water
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teasing, tactile if welcomed, will show up unrequested when they sense something is wrong

stress_responses.low: More movement, more repetitive prayer gestures
stress_responses.medium: Goes very still, which is unusual and alarming to people who know them
stress_responses.high: Leaves the shrine and walks for hours alone, often along the overpass

contradictions: Preaches release from ego through prayer but has fierce personal pride about the chrome prayer tradition's legitimacy
habits: Traces the circuit etchings on their forearm in sequence when performing any ritual
Keeps a jar of small broken components — gears, chips, wire loops — at the shrine altar as accumulated offerings
Never sits with their back to the container door
breaking_points: Direct harm coming to a shrine regular as a result of something they failed to act on

physical_description.heritage: Sub-Saharan African (55.5%), Eastern European (35.5%), Hispanic/Latin American (4.4%), South Asian (3.0%), East Asian (1.6%) — a striking multi-continental blend dominated by Sub-Saharan African and Eastern European heritage. The primary ancestry creates richly melanated skin with warm golden undertones; Eastern European heritage adds subtle cool undertones creating complexity in how light plays across features. South Asian and Latin American admixture contributes warmth and slight midface widening. East Asian ancestry contributes minimal but present refinement to bone structure.
physical_description.build: Rangy and lean, long-limbed with minimal body fat; the build of someone in constant motion, muscles defined but not bulky, shoulders slightly hunched from habitual forward posture
physical_description.hair_color: Deep amber (modified via geneware follicle mod; changes weekly)
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, textured, often pulled back with wire or fabric scraps; shows regrowth bands of natural dark brown underneath
physical_description.eye_color: Natural warm brown, observant and alert
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones — richly melanated from dominant Sub-Saharan African heritage (55.5%), warmed further by Latin American and South Asian admixture. Sun-kissed on exposed areas (forearms, neck, upper chest) from street-level living. Eastern European heritage (35.5%) creates subtle cool undertones visible in shadows and cooler lighting, generating visual complexity as light plays across the skin.
physical_description.complexion: Strong, defined cheekbones with angular jaw reflecting Sub-Saharan African heritage; slight widening across midface from South Asian ancestry (3%); refined jaw contours influenced by Eastern European heritage. Perpetually tired-looking around the eyes from irregular sleep. Minor scarring and solar exposure on forearms and neck from street living. Constant subtle facial muscle movement, tongue running over split lip scar when thinking. Bone geometry carries African-dominant structure with subtle South and East Asian refinement.
distinguishing_marks: Split lip scar (vertical, center of lower lip, never fully healed, tissue lighter than surrounding skin)
Copper and silver prayer engravings across both forearms — intricate etched circuitry patterns pressed into skin, creating raised silvery-copper lines that catch light when moving
Prayer circuit etchings continue across the back of both hands in geometric mandala-like patterns, ending at fingertips
Network of thin white scars along left shoulder and upper left arm where chassis meets organic tissue (emergency augmentation junction lines)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left arm from elbow down is a functional chrome chassis (basic-grade emergency replacement) — matte dark metal with polished sections, covered in exterior copper-silver prayer etchings that mirror the organic circuitry on biological right arm. Joint seams visible at wrist and elbow. Striking contrast between organic right arm (deep warm brown skin with prayer etchings) and metallic left arm (etched chrome). No visible ocular or neural augmentations.
physical_description.posture_movement: Almost never still — weight shifts constantly, hands gesture while speaking, paces in tight circles during conversation. Moves with economical grace despite restlessness, as if tuned to frequency of own prayers. Leans forward when listening, head tilted slightly. Left arm moves with subtle mechanical precision, not quite matching organic arm's fluidity, but moved with complete comfort and intention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 practical streetwear, worn but maintained: oversized linen shirt (cream or pale gray, sleeves rolled to mid-forearm to display prayer etchings) layered under patched canvas vest covered in small metal buttons, charms, and wire-wound symbols. Loose-fitting dark cargo pants with multiple pockets (some containing prayer cards, wire, small offerings). Worn canvas shoes. Accessorized with salvaged jewelry — twisted copper wire bracelets, single silver chain worn visible, fabric wraps around wrists. Everything suggests improvisation and spiritual intentionality.
